questions.question: 1. What is the primary objective of optimal foraging theory?

answers.a: To maximize the number of flowers visited per day
answers.b: To maximize the net rate of energy gain while foraging
answers.d: To maximize the amount of pollen collected

questions.question: 2. In a bumblebee colony, the primary role of a foraging worker is to:

answers.a: A. Protect the queen from predators
answers.c: Collect nectar and pollen for the colony

questions.question: 3. According to the theory, how does a bumblebee typically forage on a lupine plant?

answers.a: It begins at the top flower and moves downward.
answers.c: It starts from the lowest flower and moves upward.
answers.d: It visits only the middle flowers.

questions.question: 4. In the mathematical model, what does the denominator of the net energy equation represent?

answers.a: Total nectar available in the plant
answers.b: Total calories obtained from flowers only
answers.c: Total time spent foraging on the plant and moving to the next plant

questions.question: 5. In the mathematical model, the parameter - P represents:

answers.a: The probability that the plant has not been drained of nectar
answers.d: Number of pollinators visiting the plant
